# Developing Salesforce with AI Agent without generating technical debit

> Markdown (GEO/AEO) version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/salesforce-agentic-dev>. Author: **Maurício Yokoyama Issei** · en-BR · Published: 2026-04-20 · Updated: 2026-06-21.

## In short

Useagentic AI in Salesforce **without accumulating technical debt** requires method: AI implements against a **versioned specification**, not against loose prompts, and each change goes through governance and automatic validation before deploy.

- **Spec-Driven Development** — the spec is the source of the truth; Devin implements against her.
- **Federated Model** — autonomy of squares with central governance via Flosum CLI.
- **Automatic validation** — Apex Tests and gates prove intention before promoting.
- **Salesforce CLI + Git** — the state of a versed and auditable metadata.

## Why the technical debt appears

Technical debt with AI arises when code is generated without contract and without validation — beautiful in demo, fragile in production. The antidote is Spec-Driven Development with automatic gates: AI implements against spec and nothing is promoted without proof that the intention has been fulfilled.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How to use agentic AI in Salesforce without generating technical debit?**

Making the IA implement against a versioned specification (Spec-Driven Development) instead of loose prompts, and validating each change with Apex Tests and Gates before deploy. Technical debt is born from generating code without contract; the method changes the "twisting to work" for auditable intent.

**What is the Federated Development Model?**

It is an arrangement that gives autonomy to the squares to deliver quickly, maintaining central governance on quality and security (via Flosum CLI and common policies). Decentralizes execution without decentralising risk.

**What's Devin's role in this flow?**

Devin is the agent that executes the implementation against spec: discovers the relevant context, edits the metadata/Apex and runs the tests. The human acts as Cognitive Orchestrator, defining intention and judging the result.

**How does Flosum and Salesforce CLI get in?**

Salesforce CLI reviews the state of metadata in Git, making each change traceable; Flosum CLI applies governance (approvals, policies, promotion between environments) on this treadmill. Together they guarantee speed with control.
